name: proyecto-gimnasio
description: Monorepo de la plataforma web de entrenamiento asistido.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend "npm run dev --workspace=@gym/backend" "npm run dev --workspace=@gym/frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && npm run motor:lint
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run motor:test
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run motor:typecheck
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
